2018 was a very special year for me because I spent one on one
time with Ram Dass in Hawaii and presented a major keynote at
the Thinkers50 European Business Forum in Denmark with some
of the world's leading business management thinkers.
Thinkers50 wrote: "Tania brings her own special magic to an
event. She combines valuable insights with a fantastic singing voice
— a truly unique experience. She electrified the 2018 European
Business Forum."
I then performed and spoke in Vienna for the launch of a book at
the Australian High Commission about families who had escaped
the Nazi regime and created new lives in Australia. Many of you will
know that my grandparents were famous artists and that my
grandmother invented the foldable umbrella in Vienna in 1929. My
mother was just 3 months old when they managed to escape!
Following the launch of my mother's book Driftwood last year, we
are developing a music theatre work to bring this incredible story of
survival and creativity to the stage.
I was very honored to have been named in the 100 Women of
Influence and the 100 Most Influential Entrepreneurs in
Australia! We also celebrated the 10th Anniversary of Creativity
Australia and the With One Voice programs.
This year holds a number of exciting challenges and opportunities
including:

New keynote speech topics
I am stepping up my thinking on how we manage and prepare for
rapid change and increasing uncertainty, and develop the creative,
agile and entrepreneurial mindsets to navigate uncharted terrain. I
have developed some new keynote topics including:
Human Intelligence
How to manage change in an era of disruption and build a
collective future?
It is no ordinary time in the history of civilisation. The world is
moving faster than we can think, so we have to change our
thinking!
The transformation upon us means at least three things...Fear,
change and opportunity. What if you could fast-track your
thinking about change and the future? As the pace of change
accelerates, we are increasingly asking individuals and
organisations to become more agile. How can organisations
develop creative, inclusive, resilient and innovative cultures and
develop the agility required to manage and prepare for a rapidly
